method: Static source and test review plus Chromium runtime control snapshots. The audit read all JSX templates and styles. It accounts for 108 semantic interactions and 108 static JSX control templates; the counts happen to match but mappings are not one-to-one. Repeated data-driven instances with identical behavior are represented once, while distinct conditional contexts such as the empty Workout start CTA are separate rows. Runtime snapshots capture representative accessible role/name trees, and each testTitles entry is an exact Playwright title/file whose executed assertions cover that row. This semantic grouping is a traceability method, not a claim that every physical input mode/device has been exercised.
browserLimit: Required desktop projects passed the full configured suite in two hosted runs on 64dd74d. Row statuses retain assertion-scope gaps. Hosted results are aggregate annotations, not individually downloaded reports; see hosted-ci-evidence.json. Local system-Chromium individual evidence remains in verification-results.json.
